name: xchain-contracts
description: XChain Platform contract template & pattern library: audited, copy-pasteable smart contracts plus a scaffold + lint CLI

engines.comment: Bounded to Node 22: the tests load xchain-vm, whose isolated-vm binding is V8-ABI-specific (Node 24 cannot build it). See .nvmrc.

scripts.ci: node bin/ci-preflight.js && npm test && npm run lint
scripts.testComment: test/preflight.test.js runs FIRST and has no try/catch: without it a machine that cannot load isolated-vm reports 52 passing / 243 pending / exit 0 while 82% of the suite silently skips. test/gate-wiring.test.js locks that wiring in. See bin/ci-preflight.js for the same proof ahead of `npm run ci`.
scripts.test: mocha --timeout 0 --exit test/preflight.test.js test/gate-wiring.test.js escrow/escrow.test.js vesting/vesting.test.js crowdsale/crowdsale.test.js amm/amm.test.js treasury/treasury.test.js patterns/patterns.test.js patterns/patterns.e2e.test.js patterns/oz-aliases.test.js cardDispenser/cardDispenser.test.js urlOracle/urlOracle.test.js priceBet/priceBet.test.js priceBetTimed/priceBetTimed.test.js stableVault/stableVault.test.js escrowDelivery/escrowDelivery.test.js englishAuction/englishAuction.test.js dutchAuction/dutchAuction.test.js counterpartyBridge/counterpartyBridge.test.js lib/policy-gen.test.js lib/policy-gen.e2e.test.js lib/dependency-advisories.test.js
